The links to videos are given in [asl-mtp.csv](https://github.com/serpilkarabuklu/SL-Models-Analysis/blob/main/data/asl-mtp.csv) file. 
Most links will direct you to a single video. Yet, some links will have more than one video due to ASLLRP's structure and set up. In those cases, you can get the video which is used in the experiment, by combining it with information in either video id or matched translation column in the file.
